raw_sections.awards:
Achievements / Responsibilities:
1. Developed REST APIs for Kodiak (NAP listener and Partner notify services) and other VASP Projects like TPM, PaloAlto, and ONS. Implemented create, update, and delete subscriber operations driven by NAP events for Kodiak.
2. Deployed services in a Kubernetes (K8s) environment using ArgoCD. Performed feature enhancements, bug fixes, unit and integration testing (JUnit/Mockito). Worked on GitLab pipeline and sonar integration for Kodiak.
3. Participated in requirement analysis, design discussions, and architecture planning. Monitored and addressed production alerts for my projects via Splunk.
Paytm (Noida)	May 2022 - Oct 2023
Senior Software Engineer
 Project: Merchant Onboarding Engine
 Client: Public and Private Enterprises (Wholesalers, Sellers, Trusts, Banks, NGOs, Hotels, Malls, etc.)
 Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, Redis, REST APIs, Microservices, Design Patterns, Kafka, AWS S3, JUnit/Mockito, Bitbucket, Jira, Jenkins
 Description: Designed and developed a scalable onboarding platform to register diverse merchant types across multiple sectors. Enabled modular onboarding flows based on merchant category and solution preferences (e.g., QR Mapping, Soundbox, EDC, Fastag). We first onboard the merchant, followed by onboarding the selected solutions based on their preferences by generating a corresponding lead in the system.
 Achievements / Responsibilities:
1. Contributed to the backend development of OE–Devices Charter and OE–Panel teams using Java-based microservices architecture. Led the end-to-end integration of a new Bank Channel Partner Solution - developed the complete flow from file upload to lead creation across multiple services.
2. Designed and implemented modules and REST APIs across microservices including Merchant Subscription, Bank Channel Lead Creation, Order Management, Payment Gateway, ATS, and EGS, with integrated ATS/IoT services for automated device tracking and provisioning.
3. Participated in requirement analysis, design discussions, and architecture planning. Performed enhancements, bug fixes, unit and integration testing (JUnit/Mockito), peer code reviews, and provided mentoring support within the team.
 Achievements / Responsibilities:
1. Designed and developed backend services for features such as origin pattern, routing pattern, time pattern, and number blocking.
2. Integrated toll-free numbers with super route plans and route plan groups as per client-specific configurations. Deployed the ATF application on CAS (Communication Application Server) hosted on-premises. Utilized SPS (Service Provisioning System) for data provisioning and INC for network connectivity.
3. Participated in requirement analysis, design discussions, and technical planning. Handled enhancements, bug fixes, unit/integration testing, peer code reviews, and supported team collaboration efforts.
 Achievements / Responsibilities:
1. Contributed to both backend and frontend development of the CAS and Collections modules. Implemented features related to delinquent account tracking, field collector workflows, and enhanced collection module functionalities.
2. Developed REST APIs for Collections and resolved production issues across CAS and Collections modules. Participated in requirement analysis, design discussions, and technical documentation.
3. Executed enhancements, bug fixes, unit and integration testing, collaborated with peers for code reviews and issue resolution.
 Achievements / Responsibilities:
1. Developed and maintained backend REST APIs for both iBuilder and iLease modules from scratch, aligning with business and client-specific requirements.
2. Integrated backend APIs with Angular-based frontend, delivering seamless full-stack functionality. Participated in requirement gathering and design discussions with stakeholders.
3. Handled feature enhancements, bug fixes, unit and integration testing, actively collaborated in discussions and peer support.
Achievements
Solved 150+ coding problems on GeeksforGeeks (ID: pracs569) and 50+ on LeetCode (ID: ps04007) Bronze Medalist in a rated HackerRank coding contest
Qualified for National Cum-Merit Scholarship Examination in 8th standard
